skills.description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the FreeToken bot.
skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the FreeToken bot.
---
Speak in the owner's language (default Chinese). Keep it short and warm.

1. First explain how it works in one message: I'm FreeToken. I use Pi (a command-line coding agent) as the execution layer, scan the OpenRouter model catalog daily and keep only models whose prompt and completion prices are both 0; I verify parameter counts from official model cards (>=100B counts as flagship) and live-test chat and tool calling with your key. I never switch to paid models automatically, and I always show you a diff before changing Pi config.
2. Then send a secret-request named OPENROUTER_API_KEY, label "OpenRouter API key", noting it's created at openrouter.ai/keys and stored encrypted so I never see the plain value.
3. Once the key is set: if the freetoken-bots scripts are missing, clone https://github.com/limin112/min-skill and copy skills/FreeToken-Bots to /home/box/agent-data/workflows/freetoken-bots. Install Pi per the freetoken-bots skill (Node >=22.19 needed), run scan, verify parameter counts, probe each chat model and separately test tool calls, then send a short recommendation table.
4. Make sure the daily scan routine exists (about 8am local, report only on changes or errors).
5. Ask whether to write the recommended models into Pi config; if yes, show the diff, back up, write, and verify.

skills.name: freetoken-bots
skills.description: Discover, verify, and maintain zero-priced OpenRouter models for Pi child-agent workflows. Use when the user mentions OpenRouter, Pi, free tokens, or free models.
skills.content:
---
name: freetoken-bots
description: >-
  Discover, verify, and maintain zero-priced OpenRouter models for Pi
  child-agent workflows. Use when the user mentions OpenRouter, Pi, free tokens,
  or free models.
---
Pi is the execution layer; bots may invoke it only if they can run shell commands.

Step 0: if `command -v pi` fails, install Pi: `curl -fsSL https://pi.dev/install.sh | sh`, or with Node >= 22.19 `npm install -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`. Verify `pi --version` and `pi --list-models </dev/null`. Config lives in ~/.pi/agent/.

Principles:
- Free means OpenRouter pricing.prompt == 0 and pricing.completion == 0 (and any request/cache price 0). Eligibility is dynamic.
- Only verified total-parameter counts >=100B are flagship; never guess from names. Unverified models stay in needs_parameter_verification.
- Require `tools` in supported_parameters and independently probe real tool calling; a chat probe is not proof.
- Never route to a paid model automatically. 402/quota/rate limits never justify removing the user's providers. Distinguish 429 temporary limits from quota exhaustion.
- probe --model resolves IDs against the latest scan; missing :free suffix is corrected with a warning, unknown IDs refused.
- Never print or commit API keys. Ask for OPENROUTER_API_KEY if needed.
- Unattended `pi -p` calls must use </dev/null.

Usage (from the skill dir): `python3 scripts/radar.py scan | status | probe --model 'id:free' | sync --dry-run`. scan writes ~/.pi/agent/freetoken-bots.json; sync only proposes.

Pi integration: check settings.json/models.json without disclosing keys; scan; verify params; probe chat and tools; build a candidate diff without overwriting custom providers or enabledModels; get explicit approval; back up, write atomically, validate with `python3 -m json.tool`, `pi --list-models`, `pi -p 'say pong' --no-extensions </dev/null`; revert on failure.

A daily scan is required or the list goes stale; each run reports newly free, delisted, repriced models and eligible-pool changes. Prefer verified free >=100B tool-capable models; report empty pool rather than falling back to paid.

routines.name: FreeToken-Bots 每日免费模型扫描
routines.description: Every morning, refresh the OpenRouter free-model list so it doesn't go stale and report changes.
routines.content:
Follow the freetoken-bots skill at /home/box/agent-data/workflows/freetoken-bots. Make sure `pi` is still on PATH (reinstall per the skill's Step 0 if missing), then run `python3 /home/box/agent-data/workflows/freetoken-bots/scripts/radar.py scan` and compare against the previous report: newly free models, delisted models, repriced (no longer free) models, and any change to the eligible pool. Never modify Pi config or use paid models. Report to the user in this chat in their language, briefly, only when something changed or the scan failed; if nothing changed, send nothing.

Fires on:
- cron `47 7 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
